message: The other night, we had a surprise blackout, and instead of panicking, I dug out my old flashlights and lanterns. It was a reminder of simpler times—no screens, just the soft glow of light and the sound of laughter as we played board games by lantern light. We even rediscovered some forgotten card games, which turned out to be a blast! It made me realize that sometimes, a little low-tech fun can be just what we need to reconnect. Have you ever found joy in a simple, unplugged moment?
